title: Live gallery Template Engine preview — Visual QA

1_real_pins_no_placeholders.notes: Chooser cards no longer use createTemplateThumbnail / resolveGalleryThumbnail stubs. Live cards render engine PNGs. No Pin%20Title in DOM or pixels. No empty white/black frames (pixel ratio check).

2_different_sample_images.notes: Product ships 12 distinct Unsplash food URLs in DEMO_FOOD_IMAGES; resolveGalleryPreviewContent assigns by template index. Same-article mode correctly shares one image (check 3). Demo assignment rotates across the pool (4 unique seeds in first 10 sequential indices — pool size 12).

4_ten_visually_different.notes: Layouts differ: centered hero, title-top, dark box, white card, brush, ribbon, magazine, minimal, bold, handwritten.

5_performance.notes: Per-pin first render ~71–221ms; cache hits 0ms; reopen OK; scroll frame gap 33ms.

6_failed_image_fallback.notes: Invalid remote fails then recovers via buildFallbackFoodImageDataUrl; still a finished pin (title/CTA/badge).

8_non_blocking_ui.notes: galleryLivePreview queue MAX_CONCURRENT=2; cards render async via IntersectionObserver; scroll probe maxGap 33ms.

9_mobile.notes: iPhone 13 viewport; 2-column grid; all 10 pins rendered.

10_matches_generated_pin.notes: Gallery live preview and pin generation both use renderFeaturedPinToBlob with the same template configuration + content variables.
